content.text: what does the widget cache do on a cold start

content: On a cold start the widget cache is empty, so the first read for each widget id goes to the database and the result is written back into the cache. Nothing is prefetched.

content: WidgetStore owns eviction. WidgetCache only holds the map and has no eviction method of its own, so anything that removes an entry has to go through the store.
